figures.Fig18.5: The Rh-blood group system. Original figure archived as c12-bio-ch18-fig-abo-rh (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).

findings: The book dates the discovery of the Rh antigen to the 1930s; it is usually credited to Landsteiner and Wiener in 1940. The lesson gives both, flagged.
The book says allele d 'inhibits the formation of Rh-antigen'; the lesson adds that a dd person makes no Rh antigen, which is the usual description (d gives no D antigen).
